title: 第十三章：猫科类动物的弱点
content_zh:
半数据化有许多好处，比如能让他直观了解自身的实力。
这样想来，变强的方法就简单不少，只要在提升身体各项属性的同时，也增强实战能力。
属性再强，如果在战斗中不能发挥出来，根本没有意义。
而且苏晓猜测，他既然能被传送到海贼世界，那也一定会被传送到其他世界，到时有大把的机会变强。
他现在的属性是：力量7点，敏捷7点，体力5点，智力6点，魅力3点，而幸运，只有可怜的1点。
力量与速度属性不用解释，作用非常直观，与他的近战能力息息相关。
体力是代表生命力的强弱，以及抗击打能力，智力是法术类，作用现在并不明了。
魅力就让人更加疑惑，难道提升魅力会让他更加帅气？
苏晓摇了摇头，魅力属性应该并非如此，应该是提升交际类或召唤类。
至于最后的幸运属性，应该是一种很重要的属性，非常逆天，但提升难度应该很大。
苏晓擅长用刀，今后的发展可能是与力量、敏捷等属性相关，现在他还没确定发展方向，这毕竟是他经历的第一个衍生世界，思考这种问题过早。
在苏晓思索间，远处森林中传来树枝咔吧、咔吧的断裂声，一只庞大的野兽正在靠近。
逐渐靠近的正是科尔波山的主人，一只体型庞大的巨虎，。
这只巨虎与普通老虎的外貌相似，只是体型庞大，高四米多，体长至少有七、八米左右，比地球上的大象还要庞大一些，这家伙足有房屋大小。
巨虎深黄色的毛发非常富有质感，毛发光亮，在明媚的阳光下反射着微光。
苏晓藏身在大树上，紧盯着下方的巨虎，甚至于压低了呼吸声。
这种猛兽，就算是细微的声音也可能被它察觉，所以苏晓异常谨慎。
在靠近苏晓布置的陷阱后，巨虎鼻头耸动，仿佛嗅到了危险，迟迟不肯靠近陷阱。
但陷阱上那几颗干果，却对这只巨虎有致命的吸引力。
这几颗干果是苏晓在王都杂货铺买到，名为木天芷。

木天芷是海贼世界特有的干果，在现实世界，有一种植物与木天芷的功效类似，那就是猫薄荷。
科尔波山的主人虽然体型庞大，但也无法克服猫科类动物的本能，对于类似猫薄荷的木天芷，根本没有抵抗力。
要知道，猫薄荷可是有猫毒|品的称呼，对于大部分猫科类动物都有致命的吸引力。
看巨虎那垂涎欲滴的目光，苏晓就知道，他的计划很成功。
巨虎在陷阱周围踱步，非常谨慎，它闻到了陌生的气味，但并没感觉到危险。
终于，在木天芷的诱惑下，这只巨虎逐渐靠近陷阱的中心。
巨虎先谨慎的前行几步，之后马上停止，居然开始扭头向四周扫视。
树上的苏晓眼角抽动，心中暗叹，海贼世界动物的智商要比普通野兽高很多。
从巨虎的表现来看，至少有十岁左右儿童的智商，甚至更高。
时间在指间流过，漫长的僵持开始，这是耐心的比拼。
最终，科尔波山的主人抵不住木天芷的诱惑，扑上前去。
“轰。”
灰尘涌起，科尔波山的主人一口把地上的木天芷全部含在口中，开始咀嚼。
木天芷的味道并不好，不仅苦而且很涩，但科尔波山的主人却嚼的有滋有味。
咀嚼了一会后，科尔波山的主人开始出现反应，从本来的卧姿变成四脚朝上，后背在草地摩擦着。
科尔波山的主人，在打衮~。
家猫在食用大量猫薄荷后，就是现在的反应，出现幻觉，并且满地打滚。
科尔波山的主人虽然长相威武，但却无法克制这种本能，从那不停流口水的嘴角能看出，它此时陷入幻觉中。
时机已经成熟，苏晓举起手中的燧发枪，对准了那只巨虎身下的地面？
没错，就是地面，他手中这把燧发枪，就算对准科尔波山的主人眼球开上一枪，那只巨虎也是只伤不死，而以他的枪法，无法保证能命中巨虎的眼球。

在巨虎身下的泥土中，苏晓埋设了大量炸药。并且在炸药的上方，他还做了一些其他手脚，足够这只巨虎喝一壶。
平伸手臂，扣动燧发枪的扳机。
“砰。”
一声枪响在森林中传开，打破了森林的平静，惊起大片飞鸟。
经过火药爆燃的炙烤，一颗灼热的子弹从枪口飞出，在空气中推开道道气浪，旋转着没入地面的泥土内，一株翠绿的小草被打断，破碎的叶片溅起。
通红的子弹先是穿透地表泥土，之后没入埋设在地下的火药桶中，几百度的高温瞬间将火药引燃。
这突如其来的枪响，让正在地上打衮的科尔波山的主人身体一抖，马上想起身跑来，但为时已晚。
“轰。”
巨响在森林内传开，方圆一公里内所有动物都被吓的身体一抖，向生源的方向看去。
埋设在地下的十多个炸药桶被接连引爆，形成了连锁爆炸，巨响汇聚成了一声。
‘科尔波山的主人’所处那片地面泥土飞溅，成溅射形向四周喷涌，在喷溅出的泥土中，还能隐约看到一些铁钉，那是苏晓放置在炸药桶上，增加爆炸的杀伤力。
‘科尔波山的主人’这只体重足有几吨庞然大物，被身下爆炸的冲击力顶起足足有三米高，几百根铁钉借助爆炸的冲击力深深没入它体内。
“吼~。”
凄厉的虎啸传来，但噩梦并没到此终止。
火光冲天而起，将半空中‘科尔波山的主人’吞没，一股毛发的焦糊味传来。
“砰。”科尔波山的主人落地，火药燃烧后产生的浓烟将这只巨虎吞没，其中还传来滋滋的燃烧声。
苏晓站在远处的大树上，冷眼旁观这一切，但面色不算好看。
并不是他同情心发作，那种东西他早已经拿去喂狗。
他脸色难看的原因是因为那只巨虎并没死亡，至少轮回乐园没给出提示。
计划进行的很顺利，但海贼世界生物的强大却让人胆寒。

从树上跃下，赤|膊上身的苏晓抽出腰间的【斩龙闪】，单手持刀向那团烟雾走去。
既然炸不死，那就砍死，只要有一丝胜利的希望他就有胆量一战，他从不畏惧战斗。
从某种角度来讲，苏晓是一个热衷于战斗的人。
战斗时那生死一线的感觉，会让他忘记仇恨，忘记曾经的不幸，全身心投入到战斗中，直到将敌人斩杀为止。
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
Semi-digitalization has many benefits, such as allowing him to intuitively understand his own strength.
Thinking about it this way, the way to become stronger is much simpler, as long as you improve the various attributes of your body while also enhancing your actual combat ability.
No matter how strong your attributes are, if they can't be used in battle, it's completely meaningless.
And Su Xiao guessed that since he could be transported to the pirate world, he would definitely be transported to other worlds, and there would be plenty of opportunities to become stronger.
His current attributes are: 7 points of strength, 7 points of agility, 5 points of physical strength, 6 points of intelligence, 3 points of charm, and only a pitiful 1 point of luck.
There is no need to explain the attributes of strength and speed. Their functions are very intuitive and closely related to his melee combat ability.
Physical strength represents the strength of vitality and the ability to withstand attacks. Intelligence represents spells, and their functions are not yet clear.
Charisma makes people even more confused. Could improving charm make him more handsome?
Su Xiao shook his head. The charm attribute should not be like this. It should be to improve the communication or summoning type.
As for the final luck attribute, it should be a very important attribute, very unbelievable, but it should be very difficult to improve.
Su Xiao is good at using knives, and his future development may be related to attributes such as strength and agility. He has not determined the direction of development yet. After all, this is the first derivative world he has experienced, and it is too early to think about such issues.
While Su Xiao was thinking, the sound of branches snapping and snapping came from the distant forest, and a huge beast was approaching.
What was gradually approaching was the owner of Mount Kolbo, a huge giant tiger.
This giant tiger looks similar to an ordinary tiger, except that it is huge, more than four meters high and at least seven or eight meters long. It is larger than elephants on the earth. This guy is the size of a house.
The giant tiger's dark yellow hair is very textured and shiny, reflecting the shimmer in the bright sunlight.
Su Xiao hid in the big tree, staring closely at the giant tiger below, even lowering his breathing.
This kind of beast may detect even the smallest sound, so Su Xiao is extremely cautious.
After approaching the trap set by Su Xiao, the giant tiger's nose twitched, as if it smelled danger and refused to approach the trap.
But the few dried fruits on the trap had a fatal attraction for this giant tiger.
These dried fruits were bought by Su Xiao at the Wangdu grocery store and were named Mu Tianzhi.
Mutianzhi is a dried fruit unique to the pirate world. In the real world, there is a plant with similar effects to mutianzhi, and that is catnip.
Although the owner of Mount Colpo is huge, he cannot overcome his feline instincts and has no resistance at all to the catnip-like wood Tianzhi.
You know, catnip is called a cat poison and is fatally attractive to most felines.
Looking at Juhu's salivating eyes, Su Xiao knew that his plan was successful.
The giant tiger paced around the trap, very cautiously. It smelled a strange smell, but did not feel any danger.
Finally, under Mu Tianzhi's temptation, the giant tiger gradually approached the center of the trap.
The giant tiger took a few cautious steps forward, then immediately stopped and actually started to turn its head and glance around.
Su Xiao's eyes twitched in the tree, and she sighed in her heart. The animals in the pirate world have much higher IQs than ordinary beasts.
Judging from the giant tiger's performance, he has at least the IQ of a ten-year-old child, or even higher.
Time passes between the fingers, and a long stalemate begins. This is a competition of patience.
In the end, the owner of Mount Kolbo couldn't resist Mu Tianzhi's temptation and rushed forward.
"Boom."
Dust rose up, and the owner of Mount Kolbo took all the wood Tianzhi on the ground in his mouth and began to chew it.
The taste of Mutianzhi is not good, it is not only bitter but also very astringent, but the owner of Mount Kolbo chews it with pleasure.
After chewing for a while, the owner of Mount Kolbo began to react, changing from his original lying position to lying on all fours with his back on the grass.The ground rubbed.
The master of Mount Kolbo is fighting~.
After eating a large amount of catnip, domestic cats reacted like they did now, hallucinating and rolling around on the floor.
Although the owner of Mount Colpo looks majestic, he cannot restrain this instinct. It can be seen from the drooling corners of his mouth that he is trapped in a hallucination at this time.
The time has come. Su Xiao raised the flintlock gun in his hand and pointed it at the ground under the giant tiger?
Yes, it was on the ground. Even if he aimed the flintlock gun in his hand at the eyeball of the owner of Mount Colpo, the giant tiger would only be injured. And with his shooting skills, there was no guarantee that he would be able to hit the eyeball of the giant tiger.
Su Xiao buried a large amount of explosives in the soil under the giant tiger. And on top of the explosives, he also made some other tricks, which were enough for this giant tiger to drink a pot.
Stretch your arm flat and pull the trigger of the flintlock gun.
"Bang."
The sound of a gunshot spread through the forest, breaking the tranquility of the forest and startling a large number of birds.
After being burned by the explosion of gunpowder, a hot bullet flew out from the muzzle of the gun, pushing up waves of air in the air and spinning into the soil on the ground. A green grass was interrupted, and broken leaves splashed up.
The red bullet first penetrated the soil on the surface, and then sank into the gunpowder barrel buried underground. The high temperature of several hundred degrees instantly ignited the gunpowder.
The sudden gunshot made the owner of Mount Corpo, who was meditating on the ground, tremble and immediately wanted to get up and run, but it was too late.
"Boom."
The loud noise spread in the forest, and all the animals within a kilometer radius were frightened and looked towards the direction of the source of life.
More than a dozen explosive barrels buried underground were detonated one after another, forming a chain explosion, and the loud noises merged into one sound.
The soil on the ground where the 'Master of Mount Kolbo' was was splashing, spraying out in all directions. In the sprayed soil, you could vaguely see some iron nails, which Su Xiao placed on the explosive barrel to increase the lethality of the explosion.
The 'Master of Mount Colpo' was a gigantic creature weighing several tons. It was lifted up to a height of three meters by the impact of the explosion beneath it. Hundreds of iron nails were deeply embedded in its body with the impact of the explosion.
"Ho~."
The shrill tiger roar came, but the nightmare did not end there.
The fire shot up into the sky and engulfed the 'Master of Mount Kolbo' in mid-air, and the smell of burnt hair came.
"Bang." The owner of Mount Kolbo landed, and the thick smoke produced by the burning gunpowder engulfed the giant tiger, and there was also a sizzling sound of burning.
Su Xiao stood on a big tree in the distance, watching all this with cold eyes, but her expression was not pretty.
It wasn't that he was having a sympathetic attack, he had already fed that kind of thing to the dogs.
The reason why he looked ugly was because the giant tiger was not dead, at least Samsara Paradise did not give any hint.
The plan went smoothly, but the power of the creatures in the pirate world was frightening.
Jumping down from the tree, the shirtless Su Xiao took out the [Dragon Slaying Flash] from her waist and walked toward the smoke with a knife in one hand.
Since he can't be killed by bombing, he can be hacked to death. As long as there is a glimmer of hope of victory, he will have the courage to fight. He is never afraid of fighting.
From a certain perspective, Su Xiao is a person who is keen on fighting.
The feeling of life and death during the battle will make him forget his hatred and past misfortune, and devote himself to the battle until he kills the enemy.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
